contract.intent: Make the CLI result value-canonical: every command is a pure handler of a ctx returning an Outcome, a central main routes flags/exits/errors, and the default text is a render of the SAME value that --json emits — so the two formats can never diverge, and handlers become in-process testable.
acceptanceCriteria: A handler registry: each command is a function of ctx returning an Outcome (ok value or ok:false error); no handler writes stdout directly
A central main routes dispatch, the --json flag, exit codes, aliases, and the error shape in one place; default text prints render(value), --json prints the value
The composed offenders next and confirm carry the same value in text and json; the results-listing partial value is fixed

A handler-level parity test runs the handler in-process on a fixture and asserts render(value) byte-equals the real binary default stdout and --json stdout equals the value, for a representative command set
The full suite is green and ann check/verify are clean on the live journey; committed with evidence
